title: Your watches, thoughtfully presented
intro: Prepare the details, show the condition, and let the right watch find its next owner.
noRevisions: No revisions have been committed yet.
historyBody: Previous details remain attributable. Pending revisions still need fence reconciliation.
emptyBody: Create a durable draft. Nothing becomes public until your seller verification, photos, fees and sale registration are confirmed.
verificationHint: Keep preparing your draft. Publication requires current private-seller approval.
signInBody: Your listing drafts and private documents belong only to you or your authorized business. Sign in before opening the studio.
error: We couldn't complete that request. Check the current watch state before trying again.
revisionBlocked: The change was not applied. Current publication or sale commitments prevent it; reload current facts.
editPending: The revision is still awaiting confirmation. Reconcile the same operation before starting another edit.
saleModeFrozen: A published sale method cannot be changed with a facts revision.
unavailable: This service is temporarily unavailable. No sale or payment has been assumed.
forbidden: You do not have current permission for this watch or business.
stale: This watch changed elsewhere. Reload the latest revision before saving.
noDocuments: No documents supplied — disclose this honestly
ownership: I own this watch or am authorized to sell it for this business.
modifiedQuestion: Have any components been modified or replaced?
no: No modification disclosed (not an originality guarantee)
disclosureHint: A modified resale watch is not platform stock or a brand customization approval. Never imply factory endorsement.
photoHint: JPEG or PNG • 8 MB each • 20 million decoded pixels • 12 photos. Metadata is removed; three aspect-preserving sizes are generated.
documentHint: Private JPEG, PNG or PDF • 8 MB each • 5 documents. Never shown in the public gallery.
photoSafety: I checked that these photographs show only the watch: no identity documents, former-owner details or full serial numbers.
feeHint: Watch buyers pay 3% and sellers pay 5% of the watch price. Review the exact current USD fees before publishing. Collection is simulated.
publishedBody: This watch is now published in the real catalog. Publication is not a payment, inspection pass or warranty.
pendingBody: The physical-watch commitment is not yet confirmed. Retry the same operation; the watch remains private while pending.
complete: Complete required details, add a safe photo and explicitly answer the modification question.
creditsIntro: Real openly licensed photography, illustrative stock. These photographs do not prove ownership, authenticity, condition or an endorsement.
changes: Oriented, metadata removed and resized while preserving aspect ratio. Derivatives retain the stated image license; unrelated application code is not relicensed.
workspaceIntro: Your actual drafts, live watches and next steps, with each source checked independently.
noAuctions: No auctions have been opened yet.
payoutHint: No payout is implied. Confirmed payment, receipt, dispute-window completion and release are prerequisites.
retainedFile: This file remains in memory until its upload is confirmed. Retry the same upload.
scheduleHint: Publication does not open an auction. Continue to scheduling and review the published watch.
publicationReviewPending: This watch remains private until its current listing-specific possession and duplicate-stock reviews are confirmed. Retry the same publication.
publicationReviewDenied: Resolve the possession or duplicate-stock review for this listing before publishing.
revisionReviewPending: The existing published version remains visible. Confirm the current possession and duplicate-stock reviews, then retry the same revision.
revisionReviewDenied: The existing published version remains visible. Resolve the possession or duplicate-stock review and reconcile the retained revision.
uploadReview: The original upload did not commit because the listing changed or no longer accepts media. Your file remains in memory. Load and review the current version before continuing.
uploadFrozen: This listing no longer accepts media. Your file remains in memory; you can discard it.
saveReview: Your changes remain in memory. Load and review the current version before applying them to that version.
keepChanges: Keep my changes on the reviewed version
feeTerms: Collected fees are never refunded, including after cancellation, a dispute or failed authentication. A permitted full watch-price refund excludes the buyer’s 3% fee.
returnTerms: Unpaid cancellation releases the watch only when no payment attempt is uncertain. Paid cancellation before dispatch pauses fulfilment for a watch-price-only refund; after custody transfer, a controlled return or recorded failure exception is required first. Inspection and each transport trip must be quoted and explicitly accepted before payment; no free return is promised.
privateAssuranceTerms: Possession review is not authentication. A private-sale watch requires independent inspection after payment and physical receipt. The dispute window is 72 hours from recorded buyer receipt. If authentication fails, the seller still owes the 5% commission plus the disclosed return-trip cost, collected once from the saved simulated method. Return remains held until collection is confirmed and a custody instruction is recorded; declined or uncertain collection requires support review.
businessAssuranceTerms: Business assurance covers the listed identity, condition, provenance and disclosed modifications. The dispute window is 168 hours from recorded buyer receipt, with reasoned watch-price-only remedies. No independent private-sale authentication pass is implied.
